about: The Battle Hall's Fairy rank fields one of the sets of the later generations: a scratch copy of Paolo's Route 29 save put before the Hall's single-battle receptionist (savedit --where, the tile east of her, facing west) with a level 50 Typhlosion; the challenge taken, the game saved, the cursor taken up from Normal to Steel and right to Fairy, the Fairy-type rank 1 battle accepted, fought and won. On the RNG pinned before the pick the opponent is a Spritzee, a sixth-generation Fairy Pokemon the Hall had no set for: its set (Moonblast, Trick Room, Wish, Protect, an Eviolite) is one of those spread through the first strength, and only a Fairy pick brings it.
